---
title: "Transforming East Asia: Regional Integration in a Trade War Era"
description: "Open Economies Review, 2023. With Karen Jackson."
date: "2023-01-01"
categories: [trade-wars]
---

As US–China trade tensions escalated, East Asian economies deepened
regional integration with each other rather than retreating into
protectionism. We document this shift in trade patterns and ask whether it
reflects deliberate diversification away from exposure to the US–China
relationship, or simply the mechanical effect of existing regional trade
agreements taking fuller effect.

**Published in:** *Open Economies Review*, 34(3), 657–672
